turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm bringing home a second cat next week. How do I introduce them without a war?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Go slowly. Keep the new cat in a separate room for the first few days with her own food, water and litter tray.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They can't see each other at all?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not yet. Let them get used to each other's smell first. Swap their bedding or rub a cloth on one and leave it near the other.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Feed them on either side of a closed door, then a door open a crack, then a baby gate. Move on only when both are eating calmly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How long does all this take?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Anything from a week to a month. Hissing at first is normal, so don't panic if it's not instant friendship.
